title: Look Good, but NOT very functional
text: Look Good, but NOT very functional. Not a total waste of money. Mitts look nice and the design allows for multiple storing/hanging options. Convenient to hang on the oven handle for easy reach. However, the material is thin and so are the pot holder pads. Do not attempt to walk very far with a fresh out of the oven tray. They serve their purpose if you are taking a pan out of the oven to the counter next to it. Do not attempt to walk across the kitchen with anything hot.
